data.description: Luxury 7BR Villa | Prime Location | Damac Hills
data.long_description:
Experience refined luxury in this exceptional 7-bedroom villa in Autograph Collection, DAMAC Hills. Spanning 7,426 sq. ft., this prestigious residence combines contemporary architecture, expansive living spaces, and premium finishes, offering an unparalleled lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

Property Details:

Property Type: Villa
Community: DAMAC Hills
Development: Autograph Collection
Bedrooms: 7
Bathrooms: 8
Built-Up Area: 7,426 sq. ft.
Expansive living and dining areas
Modern designer kitchen
En-suite bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
Private family and entertainment spaces
Floor-to-ceiling windows maximizing natural light
Premium finishes and high-quality craftsmanship throughout

Property Amenities:

Private Garden
Swimming Pool
Fully Equipped Gymnasium
Dedicated Parking Spaces
Landscaped Outdoor Areas
Children's Play Areas
Community Parks and Green Spaces
Walking and Cycling Tracks
24/7 Security and Gated Community
Access to World-Class Recreational Facilities

Location Highlights:

Located within the prestigious DAMAC Hills community
Surrounded by lush landscapes and premium residences
Close to retail, dining, and entertainment destinations
Easy access to major road networks across Dubai
Near schools, healthcare facilities, and everyday conveniences
Access to community parks and leisure amenities
Family-friendly environment with a vibrant lifestyle offering

This remarkable villa presents a rare opportunity to own a luxurious family home in a prime Dubai location, combining space, privacy, and world-class community living.
